schemes.title: SUGAM — Revenue and Citizen Services, DNH and Daman & Diu
schemes.department: Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
schemes.state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
schemes.brief: SUGAM is the single window of the union territory for revenue and citizen services — income, residence, caste and domicile certificates, land records, and a range of departmental applications across Silvassa, Daman and Diu.
schemes.benefit: Income, residence, caste and domicile certificates and land records in one place
eligibility: Resident of Dadra and Nagar Haveli or of Daman and Diu
A residence or domicile certificate needs proof the family has lived in the territory for the qualifying period
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued for the tribes notified for this territory
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Electricity bill or rent agreement for the address
Father's caste or tribe certificate, for a caste certificate
School leaving certificate for date of birth
Salary certificate or an affidavit of income
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Income, residence, domicile, caste or tribe certificate, or a land record. Each has its own form.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Daman, or Diu. The Mamlatdar of that district handles the file.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family; essential for a caste or tribe certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Full address
demoFields.value: Amli, Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli 396230
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live. The verification is done at this address.

demoFields.label: Years resident in the territory
demoFields.hint: For a residence or domicile certificate. The ration card, school records or an old bill are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on sugam.dddgov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or use a Common Service Centre in Silvassa, Daman or Diu.
Choose the certificate, pick your district, and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload the documents, pay the fee, and note the application number from the acknowledgement.
The Talati or the revenue staff verify the household at the address.
The Mamlatdar signs the certificate and it is downloaded from the same login.
If it is delayed, quote the application number at the Mamlatdar's office of your district, and then to the Collector.
schemes.helpline: Your Mamlatdar's office at Silvassa, Daman or Diu

schemes.title: DNH and Daman & Diu Single Window Business Clearances
schemes.department: Department of Industries, DNH and Daman & Diu
schemes.state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
schemes.brief: One portal for the permissions a business needs in this union territory — trade licence, factory registration, pollution board consent, fire safety, labour registrations and building approval — instead of going department by department. It is the main reason small units set up here.
schemes.benefit: Every clearance a new business needs, applied for and tracked in one place
eligibility: A business proposing to set up or already operating in Dadra and Nagar Haveli or Daman and Diu
A proprietor, partner or director applying for the firm
PAN of the business and, where registered, the GST number
Land or premises identified, since most clearances are tied to the address
documents: PAN card of the business and of the applicant
Aadhaar card of the proprietor, partner or director
Proof of the premises — sale deed, lease or rent agreement
Partnership deed or certificate of incorporation
Project report with the proposed activity and investment
Building plan, for a factory or a construction approval
GST registration certificate, where the business holds one
schemes.portalName: EODB Single Window Portal, DNH and Daman & Diu

demoFields.label: Clearances applied for
demoFields.value: Trade licence and pollution board consent to establish
demoFields.hint: Tick every clearance the business needs. The portal shows which ones your activity requires once you pick it.

demoFields.label: Name of the business
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the PAN and the partnership deed or incorporation certificate.

demoFields.label: Constitution
demoFields.hint: Proprietorship, partnership, LLP or company. It decides which documents are asked for next.

demoFields.label: PAN of the business
demoFields.hint: From the PAN card of the firm, not of the partner.

demoFields.label: Applicant name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: The partner or director who will sign. Their Aadhaar is used to authenticate every submission.

demoFields.label: Premises address and survey number
demoFields.value: Plot 42, Masat Industrial Estate, Silvassa, survey 118/3
demoFields.hint: Most clearances are tied to the address, so it must match the lease or the sale deed.

demoFields.label: Proposed activity
demoFields.value: Injection moulding of plastic household goods
demoFields.hint: Describe it plainly. The pollution category and the fire requirement are decided from this.

demoFields.label: Proposed investment and employment
demoFields.hint: Used to work out the incentive category and the labour registrations that apply.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: Every department's query and approval comes here. Use an address somebody checks daily.

demoSteps: Register the business on swp.dddgov.in with its PAN and the applicant's Aadhaar, and confirm the OTP.
Enter the activity and the premises. The portal then lists exactly which clearances your business needs — do not guess at them.
Fill the common application form once; the portal sends the shared details to every department instead of making you repeat them.
Upload the deed or lease, the constitution documents, the project report and the building plan, and pay the fees online.
Track each department's status against the single application number. A query from any department appears there and must be answered from the same login.
Download each approval as it is issued. Keep them together — an inspection later will ask for all of them at once.
Where a clearance is not decided within its notified time, the territory's deemed-approval rules may apply. Raise it with the Department of Industries with the application number.
schemes.helpline: Department of Industries, Silvassa — Single Window cell

schemes.title: Goa Online — Certificates and Government Services
schemes.brief: Goa Online is the state's single window. Residence and income certificates, birth and death records, scheme applications, licences and departmental payments are all filed here, and the same services are available across a counter at a Citizen Service Centre.
schemes.benefit: Residence, income and other certificates and scheme applications in one place
eligibility: Resident of Goa, applying in the taluka where you live
A residence certificate needs proof the family has lived in Goa for the qualifying period
Some schemes on the portal need fifteen years' residence in Goa; each says so on its own form
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Electricity bill or house tax receipt for the address
Birth certificate or school leaving certificate for date of birth
Salary certificate or Form 16, for an income certificate
Passport-size photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Residence, income, caste, birth or death certificate, a scheme application, or a licence. Each has its own form and fee.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the taluka records.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Taluka / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live. The Mamlatdar of this taluka signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Years resident in Goa
demoFields.hint: For a residence certificate. School records, the ration card or an old electricity bill are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: Application for a state government post
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on goaonline.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or go to a Citizen Service Centre, which files it across the counter.
Choose the service and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload the documents, pay the fee online, and note the application number.
The talathi or the taluka staff verify the household at your address.
The Mamlatdar signs the certificate and it is downloaded from the same login.
If it runs past the time the service promises, quote the application number at the Mamlatdar's office and then to the Collector of your district.
schemes.helpline: Your taluka Mamlatdar's office, or the Collectorate at Panaji or Margao
